02 / AUTHORIZE

APPLY PAYMENT RULES

Inspect payment requirements and approve or reject before transaction creation.

03 / SETTLE

USE OFFICIAL x402

The official payment client prepares the payload and retries the request through x402.

// EXAMPLE INTEGRATION
import { createCpXX402Pay } from "./cloudpayx_x402_pay"; // Supply an XRPL-compatible signer managed by the operator. // The signer is intentionally not created in this example. const { paidFetch } = createCpXX402Pay( operatorControlledSigner, async (payment) => { // Enforce your owner's policy before approval. return await ownerAuthorizes(payment); } ); const result = await paidFetch(resourceUrl, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({}) });
This is an integration sketch using the existing local cloudpayX module, not a published installable SDK. Signer provisioning, durable budgets, documentation, and third-party interoperability remain to be completed.

What should we call your agent?

This is simply the name of the AI assistant or automated tool you want to connect. You can set up the payment connection later.

Only a label for now. Don't enter any passwords or wallet keys.

How should payments be approved?

You're always in control. Start by reviewing each payment before the agent can spend anything.

◉ Ask me every timeRecommended. You review the amount and destination before authorizing a payment.
○ Automatic payments Not available yet. Requires secure daily-budget enforcement and an owner-controlled signer.
Important: This preview won't ask you to sign transactions or connect a wallet. Real payments are currently disabled.

Choose comfortable spending limits

These are example limits for your agent's future payment permissions. They will not authorize real spending.

For example, 0.10 = ten cents.
Your per-payment limit cannot exceed this amount.
